findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

On arrival the ice machine was observed with black slime/mold growth accumulation. The PIC was shown and cleaned the location during the inspection to correct the immediate violation. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are maintained clean at all times to prevent possible pathogenic growth/illness.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Observed no certified food manager to be present upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, ensure a certified food manager is present within facility during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer set up to be available upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer solution was set up and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Ensure a sanitizer solution is set up during all hours of operations.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(A) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
Observed no Certified Food Manager to be in facility upon inspection. PIC has documentation that the training was completed, however no documentation that the exam was taken and passed. Discussed with PIC, ensure 1 Certified Food Manager is present at all times of operation. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed no soap to be available at the bar hand sink. Discussed with PIC, soap was replaced. Ensure all hand sinks are properly equipped to ensure proper hand washing. 

6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed no sanitizer solution to be set up during inspection. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer bottle was made and tested at 200 ppm(CL). Ensure sanitizer solution is set up at all times of operation. 

4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed no bleach test strips to be present during inspection. Facility provided Quat test strips, however Quat is not being used as a sanitizer at the moment. Discussed with PIC, bleach test were given to facility by inspector. Ensure test strips are available at all times of operation to ensure sanitizing solutions are at the correct concentration. 

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface. 

Observed the following areas in need of repairs:
1. Caulking is needed in the following areas: 3 compartment sink in back kitchen, mop sink in back kitchen, women’s hand sinks (all lack caulking from sink to wall).

Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure repairs before the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the interior of the ice machine baffle to have a layer of pink, slime-y mold when a paper towel is run along the baffle edge. Discussed with PIC. Remove the ice from the machine and wash, rinse, sanitize the interior (particularly the baffle). 

Observed both soda guns at the bar to have mold. Discussed with PIC. PIC began to wash, rinse, sanitize the nozzles during the inspection. Ensure staff is aware to throughly clean the soda nozzles. A scrub may have to be used instead of just soaking the guns in sanitizer. COS.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface. 

Observed the following areas in need of repairs:
1. Caulking is needed in the following areas: 3 compartment sink in back kitchen, mop sink in back kitchen, women’s hand sinks (all lack caulking from sink to wall).
2. The board the microwave is sitting on within the kitchen needs to be painted or sealed with clear coat. The interior of the bar cabinets needs to be painted or sealed with clear coat.
3. There is a broken piece of trim on the cabinet in the men’s bathroom hand sink area. Repair the trim.

Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure repairs before the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

On arrival, the test strips available for the sanitizer had gotten wet and were unusable.  A small amount were acquired during the inspection to correct. PIC instructed to ensure that usable test strips were available at all times. Inspector suggested maintaining a spare set in the office in case of emergency. PIC ordered multiple bottles during the inspection for future use.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text:
750.540 (C) Class II facilities are required to have a Certified Food Protection Manager at all times that foods are being handled or prepared. 

On arrival, there was not a CFPM at the facility. A CFPM arrived during the inspection to correct the violation. Both the CFPM that arrived and the PIC at inspector’s arrival did not seem aware of the requirement that the facility have one on site at all times of operation. Education took place and the PIC is instructed to ensure that a CFPM is on site at all times that food and food contact are handled.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11 (Pf) The Person in Charge shall ensure that: (O) “Food Employees and Conditional Employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as relate to disease that are transmissible through food as specified under 2-201.11 (A). 

No reporting agreements or other verifiable manner was observable during the inspection. A copy of the Sangamon County Reporting agreement was given to the PIC during the inspection. They are instructed to make copies and ensure that all Food Handlers have signed a copy. Follow up in 10 days.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text: 750.540 (C) Class II facilities are required to have a Certified Food Protection Manager at all times that foods are being handled or prepared. The PIC during the inspection is not a CFPM and another employee with that qualification was not available. PIC is instructed to ensure that, as long as the facility maintains a medium risk classification, the PIC at the facility at all times must have completed the CFPM course and have the certificate available at the facility.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text: 2-103.11 (Pf) The Person in Charge shall ensure that: (O) “Food Employees and Conditional Employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as relate to disease that are transmissible through food as specified under 2-201.11 (A). No reporting agreements or other verifiable manner was observable during the inspection. Multiple copies were provided and filled out for the available staff to correct.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.citation_text: 2-501.11  (Pf) Establishment does not have procedures for employees to follow when responding to discharging of vomitus or fecal matter. The hand out produced by this department was given to the PIC during the inspection. They are instructed to ensure that it is available for observation during an inspection.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Food contact surfaces should be maintained clean to sight and touch. The left soda gun (from behind the counter) is observed with accumulated slime in the spaces in the nozzle. The gun was cleaned and sanitized to correct.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11 (A) (P) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by Except as specified in (1)(d) below, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD.

Raw beef tips were observed stored above containers of sour cream and butter in the walk in cooler. Discussed with the PIC and the items were rearranged during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11 (A) (5) (P) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be cleaned At any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred.

1) Utensils stored on the magnetic rack were observed soiled. 2) The grates in the pizza ovens were observed soiled with accumulated food debris. The items were moved to be cleaned during the inspection.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text:
3-501.17 Refrigerated, READY-TOEAT, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD  held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded for a maximum of 7 days. The day of preparation shall be counted as Day 1. 

Sour cream was observed in the walk in cooler without a date mark. The sour cream was discarded during the inspection.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.citation_text:
6-202.15 (D) (C) If the windows or doors of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, or of a larger structure within which a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT is located, are kept open for ventilation or other purposes the openings shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: 1) Screen doors, 2) air curtains or 3) other effective means. 

The front door of the facility was left open during the inspection without an effective deterrent to pests in place. Discussed with the PIC and instructed them to leave the door closed until an effective method can be installed to prevent the entrance of pests.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11 (C) (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

The roof of the microwave in the facility was observed soiled with food splash. The PIC was instructed to maintain the microwave clean between uses.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-202.11 (A) (C) Light bulbs shall be shielded, coated, or other wise shatter-resistant in areas where there is exposed FOOD; clean EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, and LINENS; or unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES.

The light fixture on the roof directly as you enter the kitchen area is without the shielding present on the other fixture in the area. PIC was instructed to replace the shielding prior to the next inspection.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.
The sanitizer used at the facility is a Quat based sanitizer. The test strips used at the facility test for chlorine. Test strips used for sanitizers should test for the correct chemicals. Discussed with the PIC and instructed to acquire either a chlorine based sanitizer or test strips for a Quat based sanitizer. A few test strips were left during the inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.comment: 750-160 Observed the bartendar cutting citrus fruits using a bare hand. No gloves were available. A napkin was used as a barrier between hand and fruit. Any foods going into customer's drink should not be touched with bare hand. Fruits should be washed prior to cutting and handled with a gloved hand after washing and before going into drinks. Ready to eat foods shall be handled in a manner to minimize direct hand contact.
